RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, November 28, 2011/Agrahayana 7, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Coal; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; Corporate
Affairs; Earth Sciences; Information and Broadcasting; Law and Justice;
Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Mines; Minority Affairs;
New and Renewable Energy; Parliamentary Affairs; Power;
Science and Technology; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Improvement in conditions
of Muslims
*81. SHRI HUSAIN DALW AI : Will
the Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Sachar Committee
Report has raised concerns that though
there is considerable variation in the
conditions of Muslims across States, the
community exhibits deficits and
deprivation in practically all dimensions of
development;
(b) if so, the steps Government is
taking to improve the conditions of
Muslims in the States where the situation
is worse; and
(c) the steps Government is taking to
comply with the recommendations of the
Sachar Committee?
Distribution of food subsidy
†*82. SHRIMATI HEMA MALINI:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that distribution
of food subsidy is not being effected
uniformly by the Central Government in
accordance with the BPL population in the
States;
(b) if so, the details thereof alongwith
the reasons therefor; and
(c) if not, the details thereof?
Power situation
*83. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased
to state:
(a) the power generation from various
sources, source-wise alongwith the demand
and supply of power in the country at
present, State/UT-wise;
(b) the details of the power projects
commissioned during the last three years

26
and the current year, project-wise and State-
wise;
(c) whether the demand of power has
been continuously increasing;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) the steps taken by Government to
step up the power generation capacity in
consonance with the rise in demand of
power?
Study of earth sciences
*84. SHRI TARUN VIJAY: Will the
Minister of EARTH SCIENCES be pleased
to state:
(a) the measures Government has taken
to popularise the study of earth sciences
amongst the youths in colleges;
(b) whether Government is
contemplating any special scheme to attract
young scientists towards this stream; and
(c) the number of doctorates awarded
by various universities in the field of earth
sciences during the last three years?
Plan to bring back Indian scientists
*85. SHRI KALRAJ MISHRA: Will
the Minister of  SCIENCE AND
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has drawn any
plan to attract and bring back Indian
scientists working abroad to pursue
scientific research in the country in their
respective fields of work;
(b) if so, the details including the cost
thereof; and
(c) the steps taken so far in this
direction?
Shortage of coal in thermal power
plants in Punjab
*86. SHRI BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: W ill the Minister of
COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether there was an acute shortage
of coal in the thermal power plants in
Punjab due to which the plants could not
operate at their optimum capacity; and
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and the
remedial measures taken to avoid the
recurrence of such shortage?
Production of coal by private sector
companies
†*87. SHRI SHIV ANAND TIWARI:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that in order to
enhance coal production in the country,
Government had entrusted private sector
with the responsibility  of producing coal
by allocating them coal blocks;
(b) if so, the number of such coal blocks
that had come under the control of the
private sector till September, 2011, and the
number of coal blocks wherein coal
production had started; and
(c) the target fixed for coal production
and the actual quantity of coal produced
by the private sector upto September, 2011?
Consolidation of small mines
*88. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of MINES be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has received
diverse representations on the proposed
Mining Bill;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

27
(b) whether it is a fact that Government
proposes to close all small mines in the
country and consolidate them for
exploitation by large firms;
(c) whether Government is forming a
separate body to oversee such
consolidation; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Price rise of essential food items
*89. SHRIMATI KUSUM RAI: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) the percentage of rise in prices of
essential food items during the last three
months, item-wise and month-wise;
(b) whether food inflation has again
surged and has reached double digit in the
month of October, 2011;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) the reasons for rise in the prices of
food articles during the last three months;
and
(e) the impact of Government's policies
on the increase in the prices of food articles?
Impact of increased price of imported
coal on power generation
*90. SHRI TARIQ ANWAR: Will the
Minister of POWER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that about 30 per
cent of coal is imported from Indonesia for
power generation in the country;
(b) if so, what would be the impact of
increase in the prices of imported coal on
power generation; and
(c) what remedial steps Government is
taking in this regard?
Tribunal for inter-State water disputes
*91. SHRI T.M. SELVAGANAPATHI:
Will the Minister of W ATER
RESOURCES be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is considering to set up a standing tribunal
to adjudicate on inter-State water disputes;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the cases
of water disputes between the States have
piled up; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Prices of cereals
*92. SHRIMATI  T. RA TNA BAI: Will
the Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that prices of
cereals like wheat and rice have been
stabilized during the current year;
(b) if so, the details thereof as compared
to the last five years; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Utilization of ground/surface water
*93. SHRI N.K. SINGH: Will the
Minister of W ATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that surface water
and ground water is utilized for irrigation
of agricultural land of the country;
(b) if so, the percentage of agricultural
land which is being irrigated through
surface and ground water; and
(c) the volume of water capacity
established under water harvesting system
in order to maintain the level of ground
water?

28
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Districts under MSDP
†*94. SHRI OM PRAKASH
MATHUR: Will the Minister of
MINORITY AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of districts included
under the Multi-sectoral Development
Programme (MSDP), State-wise;
(b) the funds allocated during the last
three years and the extent of utilization
thereof by the States; and
(c) whether any district of Rajasthan is
included under the Programme and, if so,
the name of that district?
Rate of inflation
†*95. SHRI RAMCHANDRA
PRASAD SINGH:  W ill the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that inflation rate
of food items could not be brought upto
bearable limit during January, 2010 to
October, 2011;
(b) if so, Government's reaction thereto
and whether Government has assessed the
bearable rate of inflation, so far; and
(c) the months in which food inflation
rate was maximum and minimum during
the abovesaid period?
Village energy security projects
*96. SHRI Y .S. CHOWDARY: Will the
Minister of NEW AND RENEWABLE
ENERGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has identified
villages/hamlets for test projects on village
energy security throughout the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(c) the details of the test projects
undertaken in unelectrified remote villages
and hamlets during the last three years?
Crises faced by NALCO
†*97. SHRI RUDRA NARAYAN
PANY: Will the Minister of MINES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Aluminium Company (NALCO) has been
simultaneously struggling with many crises
of late;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the steps being considered by
Government to save NALCO from all these
crises?
Strengthening of judicial system
†*98. SHRI PARSHOTTAM
KHODABHAI RUPALA:  W ill the
Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the concrete steps the
Ministry is going to take for bringing
transparency in the judicial process, speedy
redressal of disputes and restoring the
dignity of judiciary;
(b) whether any proposal is under
consideration of the Ministry for providing
free and speedy justice to the poor and
middle class people so that they can have
full faith in the judicial system of the
country; and
(c) whether the Ministry is considering
any proposal for determining a specific
time-frame for the disposal of cases?

29
Coal crises due to strike in CIL
†*99. SHRI SATYAVRAT
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of COAL
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that power plants
across the country are facing coal crises
due to the strike in Coal India Ltd. (CIL);
(b) if so, the steps taken by Government
to overcome it;
(c) the extent to which it has been
successful; and
(d) the reasons for strike in CIL?
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 22nd November, 2011 Secretary-General.
Agrahayana 1, 1933 (Saka)
State funding of elections
*100. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of LAW AND JUSTICE
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to go
for State funding of elections as a major
electoral reform in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if answer to (a) be in the negative,
the reasons therefor?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
